devdoc.author: Naturelab
devdoc.details: This contract is the logical implementation of the vault, and its main purpose is to provide users with a gateway for depositing and withdrawing funds and to manage user shares.

AddressEmptyCode(address).details: There's no code at `target` (it is not a contract).

AddressInsufficientBalance(address).details: The ETH balance of the account is not enough to perform the operation.

ERC20InsufficientAllowance(address,uint2.details: Indicates a failure with the `spender`’s `allowance`. Used in transfers.

params.allowance: Amount of tokens a `spender` is allowed to operate with.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC20InsufficientBalance(address,uint256.details: Indicates an error related to the current `balance` of a `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.balance: Current balance for the interacting account.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidApprover(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `approver` of a token to be approved. Used in approvals.

ERC20InvalidReceiver(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `receiver`. Used in transfers.

params.receiver: Address to which tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSpender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `spender` to be approved. Used in approvals.

params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC4626ExceededMaxDeposit(address,uint25.details: Attempted to deposit more assets than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxMint(address,uint256,u.details: Attempted to mint more shares than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxRedeem(address,uint256.details: Attempted to redeem more shares than the max amount for `receiver`.

ERC4626ExceededMaxWithdraw(address,uint2.details: Attempted to withdraw more assets than the max amount for `receiver`.

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

FailedInnerCall().details: A call to an address target failed. The target may have reverted.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC20 token failed.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`). Note that `value` may be zero.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

collectRevenue().details: Collect performance fees to the recipient address.

createStrategy(address,bytes,uint256).details: Allows the owner to create a new strategy.

params._impl: The implementation address of the strategy.
params._initBytes: The initialization parameters for the strategy.

decimals().details: Decimals are computed by adding the decimal offset on top of the underlying asset's decimals. This "original" value is cached during construction of the vault contract. If this read operation fails (e.g., the asset has not been created yet), a default of 18 is used to represent the underlying asset's decimals. See {IERC20Metadata-decimals}.

deposit(uint256,address).details: The deposit method of ERC4626, with the parameter being the amount of assets.

params._assets: The amount of asset being deposited.
params._receiver: The recipient of the share tokens.

returns.shares_: The amount of share tokens obtained.

returns._0: Actual LP price during the user's deposit phase.
A struct containing the vault parameters.
A struct containing the vault state.

getWithdrawFee(uint256).details: Retrieve the amount of the exit fee.

params._assetAmount: The amount of asset to be withdrawn.

returns.withdrawFee_: The exit fee to be deducted.

initialize(bytes).details: Initialize various parameters of the Vault contract.

lastExchangePrice().details: If it is lower than current price, there might be a withdrawal rebalancing loss, which the user needs to bear. This usually does not happen.

returns._0: The actual LP price before the last update.

maxDeposit(address).details: Retrieve the maximum amount that can be deposited by an address.

mint(uint256,address).details: The deposit method of ERC4626, with the parameter being the amount of share tokens.

params._receiver: The recipient of the share tokens.
params._shares: The amount of share tokens to be minted.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

optionalRedeem(address,uint256,uint256,a.details: Redemption operation executed by the redeemOperator. Currently, only asset() redemptions are supported.

params._cutPercentage: The percentage of the rebalancing loss incurred.
params._owner: The owner address of the shares.
params._receiver: The address of the receiver of the assets.
params._shares: The amount of share tokens to be redeemed.
params._token: The address of the token to deposit.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

remainingUpdateTime().details: If it is not 0, the admin needs to update the price within this period.

returns._0: The remaining time. If it is 0, deposits and withdrawals are currently not allowed.

removeStrategy(address).details: Allows the owner to remove a strategy from the set.

params._strategy: The address of the strategy to be removed.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

requestRedeem(uint256).details: When a user applies for redemption, his share will be transferred to the RedeemOperator address.

params._shares: The amount of share tokens to be redeemed.

revenueExchangePrice().details: When the actual LP price exceeds this price, performance fee settlement can be conducted.

returns._0: LP price for settling performance fees.

strategies().details: Returns an array of all strategy addresses.

strategiesCount().details: Returns the number of strategies in the set.

strategyAddress(uint256).details: Returns the address of a strategy at a specific index.

strategyAssets(uint256).details: Returns the total assets managed by a specific strategy.

returns.totalAssets_: The total assets managed by the strategy.

sweep(address).details: Handle when someone else accidentally transfers assets to this contract.

params._token: The address of the token to transfer out.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

totalAssets().details: Retrieve the amount of assets in the strategy pool.

returns._0: The total assets in the strategy pool.

totalStrategiesAssets().details: Returns the total assets managed by all strategies combined.

returns.totalAssets_: The total assets managed by all strategies.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._amount: The amount of tokens to transfer.
params._strategyIndex: The index of the strategy to transfer to.
params._token: The address of the token to transfer.

underlyingTvl().details: Retrieve the total value locked (TVL) in underlying assets.

returns._0: The total value locked in underlying assets.

updateFeeReceiver(address).details: Update the address of the recipient for management fees.

params._newFeeReceiver: The new address of the recipient for management fees.

updateManagementFeeClaimPeriod(uint256).details: Update the collection cycle of management fees.

params._newmanagementFeeClaimPeriod: The new management fee claim period.

updateMarketCapacity(uint256).details: Update the size of the pool's capacity.

params._newCapacityLimit: The new size of the capacity.

updateMaxPriceUpdatePeriod(uint256).details: Update the maximum allowed price update period.

updateRebalancer(address).details: Add a new address to the position adjustment whitelist.

params._newRebalancer: The new address to be added.

updateRedeemOperator(address).details: Update the temporary address of shares when users redeem.

updateStrategyLimit(uint256,uint256).details: Update the temporary address of shares when users redeem.
